task: Build the CIMD client_id URL in codemie.enterprise.mcp_auth through one re-exported helper that adds the API root path, and drop the duplicate path constant in router.py (EPMCDME-16319).

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is _build_callback_uri (root-path join at call time) plus the dependencies re-export facade, so this is mostly copy-and-adapt. HTTPS validation stays in the enterprise _validate_client_metadata_document_url and is already covered by the AC6 test, so there is no security gap and no bump for that. The error-path template (AC6/AC7) and the monkeypatched-config route tests already exist, so the edge-case bump does not apply either. Base S because of two mechanical traps: a helper that is not re-exported fails deps resolution only at runtime, and two tests hard-code root-path-free URLs. Raised to M by the auth red flag.

4 source files modified in one package (_uri, _discovery, dependencies, router) plus 1-2 test files modified and possibly one new discovery seam test, across src/codemie/enterprise/mcp_auth and tests/ (enterprise/mcp_auth, codemie/service/mcp): about 5-7 files in 2-3 directories.

Provisionally M (URL builder, discovery config and router across the bridge and API layers). Lowered to S after calibrating against bundle example epmcdme-10102-add-validation-to-form-field: like that example, this is one self-contained component (the mcp_auth URL builder and its two callsites), and the only router change is a trivial removal of a duplicate constant. The M example epmcdme-10203 needs three layers, including a repository.
